cards.title: Should You Move Closer to Family Before School?
cards.body: A parent asks whether relocating closer to family is worth it before their daughter starts school. The advice weighs the benefits of family support against the challenges of uprooting, including lost friendships and relocation costs.

cards.title: When Adult Children Move Back Home
cards.body: A mother navigates her graduate son's return home in a tough economy, adjusting to a new phase of motherhood. She humorously reflects on how her parenting instincts resurface despite years of empty-nest living.

cards.title: Balancing Parental Duty With Personal Adventure
cards.body: An essay questions whether it's acceptable for parents to leave families—including young children—to pursue wilderness adventures or extreme challenges. It explores the tension between personal fulfillment and parental responsibility.

cards.title: What Kids Won't Tell Their Parents
cards.body: Research shows children share far more with parents they feel safe with. Learning to create that safe space is key to understanding your child's inner world.
